mapper.sql: f.fault_id as faultId , f.complaint_id as complaintId , f.station_id as stationId , f.charger_id as chargerId , f.assigned_employee_id as assignedEmployeeId , li.inspection_id as latestInspectionId , la.action_id as latestActionId , ap.document_id as approvalDocumentId , f.fault_type as faultType , f.title , f.description , f.severity , f.status , f.source_type as sourceType , s.station_name as stationName , s.address as address , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.status as chargerStatus , am.member_name as assignedEmployeeName , e.employee_no as assignedEmployeeNo , d.department_name as assignedDepartmentName , li.inspection_result as latestInspectionResult , li.description as latestInspectionDescription , li.completed_at as latestInspectionCompletedAt , la.status as latestActionStatus , la.action_type as latestActionType , la.action_result as latestActionResult , ap.status as approvalStatus , ap.title as approvalTitle , la.completed_at as latestActionCompletedAt , f.reported_at as reportedAt , f.resolved_at as resolvedAt , f.created_at as createdAt , f.updated_at as updatedAt

from fault_report f join charging_station s on f.station_id = s.station_id join charger c on f.charger_id = c.charger_id left join employee e on f.assigned_employee_id = e.employee_id left join app_member am on e.member_id = am.member_id left join department d on e.department_id = d.department_id left join lateral ( select i.* from inspection i where i.fault_id = f.fault_id order by coalesce(i.completed_at, i.inspection_date, i.created_at) desc limit 1 ) li on true left join lateral ( select ma.* from maintenance_action ma where ma.fault_id = f.fault_id order by coalesce(ma.completed_at, ma.started_at, ma.created_at) desc limit 1 ) la on true left join lateral ( select ad.* from approval_document ad where ad.fault_id = f.fault_id and ad.status not in ('반려', '취소') order by ad.created_at desc, ad.document_id desc limit 1 ) ap on true

where 1 = 1 and f.status != '취소'
and f.status = #{status}
and ( f.title ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or f.description ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(f.fault_id as varchar) = #{keyword} or s.station_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.charger_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or am.member_name ilike concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and f.reported_at >= cast(#{reportedFrom} as date)
and f.reported_at < cast(#{reportedTo} as date) + interval '1 day'
and f.resolved_at >= cast(#{resolvedFrom} as date)
and f.resolved_at < cast(#{resolvedTo} as date) + interval '1 day'
and f.assigned_employee_id = #{requesterEmployeeId}
mapper.select: select count(*) filter (where f.status = '접수') as received, count(*) filter (where f.status = '점검중') as inspecting, count(*) filter (where f.status = '조치중') as action, count(*) filter (where f.status = '결재대기') as approval, count(*) filter (where f.status = '완료') as completed

select h.history_id as historyId , h.fault_id as faultId , h.employee_id as employeeId , m.member_name as employeeName , h.before_status as beforeStatus , h.after_status as afterStatus , h.action_type as actionType , h.memo , h.created_at as createdAt from fault_history h left join employee e on h.employee_id = e.employee_id left join app_member m on e.member_id = m.member_id where h.fault_id = #{faultId} order by h.created_at asc, h.history_id asc

select e.employee_id as employeeId , e.member_id as memberId , e.department_id as departmentId , m.user_id as userId , m.member_name as memberName , m.email , m.phone , m.user_type as userType , e.employee_no as employeeNo , d.department_name as departmentName , e.position_name as positionName , e.duty_name as dutyName , e.status as status from employee e join app_member m on e.member_id = m.member_id join department d on e.department_id = d.department_id where e.status = 'ACTIVE' and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and m.user_type = 'ENGINEER' order by e.employee_id asc
select employee_id from employee where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
select user_type from app_member where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
select inspection_id from inspection where fault_id = #{faultId} order by coalesce(completed_at, inspection_date, created_at) desc limit 1
select action_id from maintenance_action where fault_id = #{faultId} and status = '진행중' order by started_at desc, action_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update fault_report set assigned_employee_id = #{employeeId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where fault_id = #{faultId}
update fault_report set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, resolved_at = case when #{resolved} = true then current_timestamp else resolved_at end where fault_id = #{faultId}

update fault_report set status = #{status}, assigned_employee_id = coalesce(#{employeeId}, assigned_employee_id), updated_at = current_timestamp, resolved_at = case when #{resolved} = true then current_timestamp else resolved_at end where fault_id = #{faultId}
update charger c set status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp, last_status_checked_at = current_timestamp from fault_report f where f.charger_id = c.charger_id and f.fault_id = #{faultId}

update complaint c set status = #{status}, admin_memo = coalesce(#{adminMemo}, admin_memo), updated_at = current_timestamp, closed_at = case when #{closed} = true then current_timestamp else closed_at end from fault_report f where f.complaint_id = c.complaint_id and f.fault_id = #{faultId} and f.complaint_id is not null
mapper.insert: insert into inspection ( fault_id , charger_id , inspector_id , inspection_type , inspection_result , description , action_required , inspection_date , created_at , updated_at ) select f.fault_id , f.charger_id , #{inspectorId} , '장애점검' , '진행중' , '시설관리담당자가 충전기 상태를 점검하고 있습니다.' , false , current_timestamp , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from fault_report f where f.fault_id = #{faultId}

insert into inspection ( fault_id , charger_id , inspector_id , inspection_type , inspection_result , description , action_required , inspection_date , completed_at , created_at , updated_at ) select f.fault_id , f.charger_id , #{inspectorId} , '장애점검' , #{inspectionResult} , #{description} , #{actionRequired} , current_timestamp , case when #{completed} = true then current_timestamp else null end , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from fault_report f where f.fault_id = #{faultId}
mapper.update: update inspection set inspection_result = #{inspectionResult}, description = #{description}, action_required = #{actionRequired}, completed_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp where inspection_id = #{inspectionId}
mapper.insert: insert into maintenance_action ( fault_id , inspection_id , charger_id , employee_id , action_type , action_result , status , started_at , created_at , updated_at ) select f.fault_id , #{inspectionId} , f.charger_id , #{employeeId} , #{actionType} , '조치 진행 중' , '진행중' , current_timestamp , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from fault_report f where f.fault_id = #{faultId}
mapper.update: update maintenance_action set status = '완료', action_result = #{actionResult}, completed_at = current_timestamp, updated_at = current_timestamp where action_id = #{actionId}
update approval_document set status = '완료', updated_at = current_timestamp, completed_at = current_timestamp where fault_id = #{faultId} and status = '최종승인'
mapper.select: select count(*) from fault_report where charger_id = #{chargerId} and status in ('접수', '점검중', '조치중', '결재대기')
mapper.insert: insert into fault_report ( station_id , charger_id , fault_type , title , description , severity , status , source_type , reported_at , created_at , updated_at ) select c.station_id , c.charger_id , #{faultType} , #{title} , #{description} , #{severity} , '접수' , #{sourceType} , current_timestamp , current_timestamp , current_timestamp from charger c where c.charger_id = #{chargerId}
